req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. The schema (TaskBase) declares title as str with min_length=1, max_length=100. Pydantic/FastAPI will reject non-string types with 422. We need: (1) a positive test confirming a valid string title is accepted (201), (2) negative tests for each non-string type (integer, float, boolean, null, array, object) returning exactly 422, and (3) a boundary test at the type boundary — a value that coerces to string vs one that does not. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 422 (not >=400), asserting 201 for the positive case, and checking the response body structure for the error detail key.

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201()
